slideDifferences.nativeText:
PHRASES
MEANING
EXAMPLE
AT THE BACK OF YOUR MIND
Something that you are not thinking about right now but is in your thoughts.
At the back of my mind is the fear of failing the exam.
A BEE IN ONE’S BONNET
An idea which constantly occupies your thoughts.
Eva's got a bee in her bonnet about moving to New York.
LIVE / BE CLOUD CUCKOO
It refers to an imaginary unrealistic place where everything is perfect and impossible things can happen.
It was not that serious. Stom making a storm in a teacup.
A FLIGHT OF FANCY
It means that something  is very imaginative but not at all practical or sensible.
Jimmy often has good ideas but his latest proposal is just a flight of fancy!
A LIGHT BULB MOMENT
A sudden moment of inspiration, comprehension or realisation.
Harry had a light-bulb moment when he finally realised what was blocking the mechanism.
BEAR/KEEP IN MIND
To remember something.
Bear in mind that no food will be served on board.
TOY WITH THE IDEA
IT means not to seriously think about something.
Sally has often toyed with the idea of moving abroad, but she's still here!
BE ALL IN YOUR HEAD
When something is just product of your imagination. It is not real.
Don't be silly. Nobody is trying to harm you. It's all in your head!
Look at the phrases and  discuss them with your teacher. Did you know them?

slideDifferences.nativeText:
STRUCTURES
ACTIVE VOICE
PASSIVE VOICE
To be + Past Participle
They build the building in glass.
The building is built in glass.
Someone stole my car yesterday.
My car was stolen yesterday.
Those are plastic chairs.
Those chairs are plastic-made.
To be + Past Participle + by
Alex will finish the job tonight.
The job will be finished by Alex tonight.
John has done the house chores lately.
The house chores have been done by John lately.
Tim had borne in mind this idea for ages.
This idea had been borne in mind by Tim for ages.
We use passive voice when we want to explain how something is done, what it is made of and who has done it.

My car was stolen yesterday. Those are plastic chairs. Those chairs are plastic-made. To be + Past Participle + by Alex will finish the job tonight. The job will be finished by Alex tonight. slideDifferences.nativeText:
Structures
ACTIVE VOICE
PASSIVE VOICE
Progressive Tenses
The boys are painting the house.
The house is being painted by the boys.
She was preparing dinner for us.
Dinner was being prepared for us.
To Consider

In active voice, we focus on who / what makes the action but in passive voice the focus goes on the object.
It is considered to be used in formal contexts; however, its use is very common.
In passive voice, the who / what makes the action can be omitted. 
In perfect tenses, we need to add the word been before the participle.
The most common progressive tenses using passive voice are present and past.
When using present and past progressive, we use the verb to be + being + the participle.
Perfect progressive tenses may also work with passive voice; however, they are not very common. E.G. Our music has been annoying the man next door - The man next door has been being annoyed by our music.

slideDifferences.nativeText:
We can use passive voice for the following functions:
Functions
Examples
1
State what things are made of
The legs of the table are iron-made.
The spoon was handcrafted in wood.
2
Declare when things are made / done.
The meeting will be set for tomorrow.
Is this piano being played this week?
3
Point who things are made / done by.
They were married, weren’t they?
You have not told them, have you?
4.
Focus on objects rather than subjects in general actions.
Why was my burger eaten from the fridge?
Five points will be taken from your test for cheating.
To consider 
Passive voice is not only used for the first three asécts; It can also be implemented in regular actions or everyday matters.

To consider Passive voice is not only used for the first three aspects; it can also be implemented in regular actions or everyday matters.

C. Read the following paragraph and identify the sentences in passive voice. What function are they representing. After that, read aloud the text to your teacher.
Hong Kong on The Loop.

The shipping industry says it's been hit by the global financial crisis and the recent spate of piracy attacks off Somalia. The chairman of the Hong Kong Ship Owners Association and chief executive of the Anglo-Eastern Group, Peter Cremers said ships are wary of sailing through the Gulf of Aden which has boosted costs as vessels are diverted. 

Analysts polled by Reuters news agency say they believe China's economy grew by just seven per cent in the last quarter of last year. If borne out by official data, this would be the worst figure in a decade. The Chinese authorities believe a minimum growth rate of eight per cent is needed to avoid severe unemployment and social disruption. China's manufacturing sector has been badly hit by recession in its main export markets.

Temperatures over Hong Kong dipped on Sunday morning with the mercury plunging to minus one degree celsius in Ta Kwu Ling. A spokesman for the Observatory said it was the lowest temperature recorded in Ta Kwu Ling since a weather station was set up there,  more than two decades ago. The Observatory says the average temperature recorded in the urban areas was 10 degrees. But, it was considerably colder in some parts of the New Territories.

AT THE BACK OF YOUR MIND
Something that you are not thinking about right now but is in your thoughts.
At the back of my mind is the fear of failing the exam.
A BEE IN ONE’S BONNET
An idea which constantly occupies your thoughts.
Eva's got a bee in her bonnet about moving to New York.
LIVE / BE CLOUD CUCKOO
It refers to an imaginary unrealistic place where everything is perfect and impossible things can happen.
It was not that serious. Stom making a storm in a teacup.
A FLIGHT OF FANCY
It means that something  is very imaginative but not at all practical or sensible.
Jimmy often has good ideas but his latest proposal is just a flight of fancy!
A LIGHT BULB MOMENT
A sudden moment of inspiration, comprehension or realisation.
Harry had a light-bulb moment when he finally realised what was blocking the mechanism.
BEAR/KEEP IN MIND
To remember something.
Bear in mind that no food will be served on board.

Don't be silly. Nobody is trying to harm you. It's all in your head!

ACTIVE VOICE
PASSIVE VOICE
To be + Past Participle
They build the building in glass.
The building is built in glass.
Someone stole my car yesterday.
My car was stolen yesterday.
Those are plastic chairs.
Those chairs are plastic-made.
To be + Past Participle + by
Alex will finish the job tonight.
The job will be finished by Alex tonight.
John has done the house chores lately.
The house chores have been done by John lately.
Tim had borne in mind this idea for ages.
This idea had been borne in mind by Tim for ages.
We use passive voice when we want to explain how something is done, what it is made of and who has done it.

texts: Structures
ACTIVE VOICE
PASSIVE VOICE
Progressive Tenses
The boys are painting the house.
The house is being painted by the boys.
She was preparing dinner for us.
Dinner was being prepared for us.

To Consider

In active voice, we focus on who / what makes the action but in passive voice the focus goes on the object.
It is considered to be used in formal contexts; however, its use is very common.
In passive voice, the who / what makes the action can be omitted. 
In perfect tenses, we need to add the word been before the participle.
The most common progressive tenses using passive voice are present and past.
When using present and past progressive, we use the verb to be + being + the participle.
Perfect progressive tenses may also work with passive voice; however, they are not very common. E.G. Our music has been annoying the man next door - The man next door has been being annoyed by our music.

texts: We can use passive voice for the following functions:
Functions
Examples
State what things are made of

The legs of the table are iron-made.
The spoon was handcrafted in wood.
Declare when things are made / done.

The meeting will be set for tomorrow.
Is this piano being played this week?
Point who things are made / done by.

They were married, weren’t they?
You have not told them, have you?
Focus on objects rather than subjects in general actions.

Why was my burger eaten from the fridge?
Five points will be taken from your test for cheating.
To consider
Passive voice is not only used for the first three asécts; It can also be implemented in regular actions or everyday matters.

texts: A. Write the corresponding passive voice for each of the sentences listed. Follow the example.

You will buy all the ingredients for the cake.

I am preparing lunch for my family. 

The have worked in the report for days.

Jake and Jill were buying a house in Miami.

I normally clean my house twice a week.

Josh usually calls his family on Saturdays.

The factory made the fabric elastic.. 

We had bought the yacht before Christmas.

They finally finished the paper last night.
My house is normally cleaned twice a week (by me).

texts: C. Read the following paragraph and identify the sentences in passive voice. What function are they representing. After that, read aloud the text to your teacher.
Hong Kong on The Loop.

The shipping industry says it's been hit by the global financial crisis and the recent spate of piracy attacks off Somalia. The chairman of the Hong Kong Ship Owners Association and chief executive of the Anglo-Eastern Group, Peter Cremers said ships are wary of sailing through the Gulf of Aden which has boosted costs as vessels are diverted.

Analysts polled by Reuters news agency say they believe China's economy grew by just seven per cent in the last quarter of last year. If borne out by official data, this would be the worst figure in a decade. The Chinese authorities believe a minimum growth rate of eight per cent is needed to avoid severe unemployment and social disruption. China's manufacturing sector has been badly hit by recession in its main export markets.

Temperatures over Hong Kong dipped on Sunday morning with the mercury plunging to minus one degree celsius in Ta Kwu Ling. A spokesman for the Observatory said it was the lowest temperature recorded in Ta Kwu Ling since a weather station was set up there,  more than two decades ago. The Observatory says the average temperature recorded in the urban areas was 10 degrees. But, it was considerably colder in some parts of the New Territories.
Adapted from https://www.eltbase.com/worksheet-714-news-stories
